reason: The action precommit requires seconds/root and branch-cost metrics but did not distinguish traversal-tree time from equal-step neural fitting time. This freeze resolves that implementation ambiguity before strategic action outputs.

tree_cost_metrics.nodes_per_root: total partial-exact advantage traversal nodes divided by completed training roots; unchanged counter semantics across candidates
tree_cost_metrics.tree_seconds_per_root: wall-clock seconds spent in root collection/traversal only, divided by completed roots; excludes Advantage/Policy optimizer fitting and checkpoint serialization
tree_cost_metrics.peak_rss: maximum resident-set size observed by the worker process, reported with platform unit normalization
tree_cost_metrics.advantage_samples_per_root: new Advantage samples seen by the reservoir divided by completed roots
tree_cost_metrics.strategy_samples_per_root: new Strategy samples seen by the reservoir divided by completed roots
tree_cost_metrics.effective_unique_aggressive_branches_per: sum of state-local deduplicated legal universal actions with slot>=2 over nonterminal advantage-traversal decision visits, divided by those visits
tree_cost_metrics.nominal_aggressive_branches_per_decision: sum of active candidate aggressive primitives slot>=2 before state-local exact-action dedup over the same advantage-traversal decision visits

operational_cost_metrics.full_training_seconds_per_root: all worker wall-clock training time through final required AveragePolicy fit divided by completed roots; retained as operational diagnostic, not substituted for tree_seconds_per_root in R7.5.4 rank-5 tree-cost cascade
operational_cost_metrics.iteration_checkpoint_to_checkpoint_secon: full iteration wall-clock duration including traversal, four exact Advantage member fits and durable checkpoint write where measured by the production calibration harness
operational_cost_metrics.rule: R7.5.4 relative tree-cost selection cannot certify the absolute 90-day production budget. R8 uses mature/worst-case complete-iteration physical timings plus all frozen non-iteration training/freeze work.
